title: Run error-review backfill and evidence derivation at drain start and
summary: At the start of every drain and in each Hestia sweep, automatically run the idempotent error-review backfill and the evidence-label derivation, and print a one-line summary of each. Also make recurrence-after-prevention label bases stable by dropping the changing closed-job count from the basis detail, so reruns write nothing. Close request 20261026-224929-6erm, citing this job. Audience: Sri and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New tests plus fmt, clippy -D warnings and the full test suite must pass.
Criteria check that the passes ran and that reruns write nothing, not that wiring exists.
The label instability is fixed at its cause, the changing count in the basis, not by deduplicating afterward.
Second-drain and rerun tests check that nothing new is written.
One focused change across the four named files.
The passes run in code at drain start and sweep, not by a documented manual step.
Doc comments and the changelog are written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Cause: evidence_labels.rs recurrence_vote puts the count of closed jobs in LabelBasis.detail, and derive() skips rewriting only when basis equals the existing basis, so the count changing as jobs close causes fresh copies. Fix: state the threshold (STOPPED_MIN_JOBS) rather than the live count, so the basis is stable while the evidence is unchanged.

The drain hook is a new Steps method with a default no-op (RealSteps implements it by calling Athena::error_review_backfill and derive_labels), called in drain_with before the queue is read; the one-line summaries go through ui or the report notes.
hestia_sweep calls the same two passes; a pass failure is reported in the summary line and does not abort the drain or sweep.
Closing request 20261026-224929-6erm is done by the landing process citing this job, not by a repo file edit.
Its asked-for status display (scored-set size, last derived time) is not part of this request's Files list, so it is left out.
Athena::error_review_backfill's existing idempotence (a second run changes nothing) is relied on, not rebuilt.

acceptance_criteria.text: A drain test in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs shows both passes (backfill and derivation) run at drain start and each prints a one-line summary; a second drain with no new records writes nothing (no new commit or records). Run: cargo test -p athena-cli drain.

A test in crates/athena-core/src/evidence_labels.rs shows a recurrence-after-prevention label is not rewritten on a rerun after more jobs have closed with otherwise unchanged evidence (derive returns no labels). Run: cargo test -p athena-core evidence_labels.
A hestia.rs test shows a sweep runs the backfill and derivation and a repeat sweep over unchanged records changes nothing. Run: cargo test -p athena-core hestia.
The recurrence-after-prevention basis detail no longer contains the live count of closed jobs, so it is the same text whenever the evidence is the same.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing automatic backfill and derivation at drain start and sweep, and the stable recurrence label, and noting that it supersedes request 20261026-224929-6erm.
Doc comments in hestia.rs and drain.rs that say a person runs athena hestia review --backfill or athena score-jev --derive are updated to say Athena runs them; the CLI commands stay available.

out_of_scope: Showing scored-set size or last-derived time in athena status (from the superseded request)
Changing how the backfill ranks or queues causes
Adding a Jev answer or making Jev scorable
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: the change spans a Steps trait hook, the sweep and a label-stability fix, with three new tests.
